b.description: multiple right-hand sides of size :math:`(*, m, k)` where :math:`*` is zero of more batch dimensions

A.description: the input triangular coefficient matrix of size :math:`(*, m, m)` where :math:`*` is zero or more batch dimensions

upper.description: whether :math:`A` is upper or lower triangular. Default: ``True``.

transpose.description: solves `op(A)X = b` where `op(A) = A^T` if this flag is ``True``, and `op(A) = A` if it is ``False``. Default: ``False``.

unitriangular.description: whether :math:`A` is unit triangular. If True, the diagonal elements of :math:`A` are assumed to be 1 and not referenced from :math:`A`. Default: ``False``.

output.description: A namedtuple `(solution, cloned_coefficient)` where `cloned_coefficient` math:`A` and `solution` is the solution :math:`X` to :math:`AX = b` (or whatever variant of the system of equations, depending on the keyword arguments.)
